$comment: Motion A v2. Whitespace is NEVER inferred from absence: partner_accounts.installed is NOT NULL DEFAULT false and written from the presence of a CSV column, so false means 'nobody told us', not 'the product is absent'. Coverage is what the partner book establishes; product-absence must be stated as evidence with polarity -1.
name: Install-Base / Whitespace Expansion
objective: Validate and advance an expansion opportunity with the partner on an account they already cover.

motion_v1.objective: Validate and advance an expansion opportunity with the partner on an account they already cover.

requires.because: evidence states the target capability is not in use at this account, which is what makes it genuine whitespace

requiresContext: Target install-base / product-state confirmation — `partner_accounts.installed` defaults to false and records only what an import happened to carry, so it cannot establish that the product is absent.
Which expansion use case the account would actually buy.
Which partner seller owns the relationship day to day — the book names the partner, not the person.
motion_v1.goalTemplate: Validate and advance an expansion opportunity with the partner at {{company}}.
motion_v1.campaignGuidance: Lead with the partner relationship, not the product. Nothing in the opening may assert what the account does or does not run — that is the first thing to find out.
measurementAssociations: An opportunity opened on this account after application — association only, never attribution.
Evidence added that establishes install-base state, which would close the largest gap.

cta.offer: Joint account review with the partner
cta.fallback: Written summary of what comparable accounts on this partner's book have adopted

Align the partner and vendor account team on the next customer action
